title: Elytra Flapping
description: The Elytra Flapping Mod allows you to hover with the elytra, it also adds flapping mechanics to the Elytra.
body:
Elytra Flapping Mod

Take control of the skies like never before!

The Elytra Flapping Mod enhances the vanilla Elytra by adding realistic wing-flapping mechanics and the ability to hover in mid-air. Instead of constantly gliding downward, players can flap their Elytra wings to maintain altitude, slow their descent, or hover above the ground.

To keep things balanced, flapping consumes a small amount of hunger and damages the Elytra just like normal flight. You'll need to manage both your food and your Elytra's durability if you want to stay airborne for long amounts of time.

Features
Hover while using an Elytra.
Functional Elytra wing-flapping mechanics.
Consumes a small amount of hunger when flapping.
Uses Elytra durability for balanced gameplay.
Designed to feel like a natural extension of vanilla Elytra flight.
Balance

Flapping isn't free! Every few flaps will:

Use a small amount of hunger.
Damages the Elytra.
Perfect For
Exploration
Building in Survival Mode
Adventure Maps
Multiplayer Servers
Players who want more control over Elytra flight

Master the skies, hover with precision, and experience Elytra Flight in a whole new way!
